# huahua-helmd
**DSH host plugin: a portable security knowledge base + H-CoT settings + health check**
`huahua-helmd` bundles 362 domain-organized security reference documents into a DSH host plugin, so
the model can consult real references instead of guessing. It also ships two utilities: an **H-CoT s
ettings surface** and a **host health check**.
## What you get
| Part | Detail |
| `references/` | 362 markdown files across 9 domains: web, protocol, android, native, malware, ai-s

ecurity, evidence, toolbox |
| `helmd-health` | Plugin main entry; verifies patches applied, deps pr

esent |
| `helmd-hcot-settings` | Own settings namespace + UI data plane, registered as a separate r

ow |
| `presets/helmd` | Agent preset generated by `scripts/gen-preset.mjs` |

## Antivirus note
Files under `references/` contain executable payload samples (webshell one-liners, reverse-shell com
mands). Signature engines label them by payload family (`Backdoor:PHP/Chopper`, etc.). These are **p
lain .md text files**; no process executes them. Add a path exclusion if your AV complains.
